description: Source code implementing archive management functions for zpaq compression, including listing, testing, extracting, adding, and deleting files within an archive, with special handling for wildcards and temporary directories.

methods.name: xa_zpaq_ask
methods.description: Configures archive capabilities and compressor settings for zpaq.

methods.name: xa_zpaq_parse_output
methods.description: Parses output lines from zpaq listing process to update archive file info.

methods.name: xa_zpaq_list
methods.description: Lists contents of a zpaq archive.

methods.name: xa_zpaq_test
methods.description: Runs a test operation on the archive.

methods.name: xa_zpaq_wildcards
methods.description: Checks for wildcard characters in file list and prevents handling if found.

methods.name: xa_zpaq_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified files from archive, handling temporary directories and file moving.

methods.name: xa_zpaq_add
methods.description: Adds files to archive with specified compression.

methods.name: xa_zpaq_delete
methods.description: Deletes specified files from archive, with checks for absolute paths.
